summary: Iter73 end-to-end testing — RSVP ticket_type fallback (Bug A), Personnel Brief OTY chapter resolution (Bug B), member OTY chapter context (Enh C), and ORB landscape Personnel Brief PDF + on-screen preview (Enh D). All 7 new backend tests + all 4 UI invariants pass. Regression: iter69/70/71 pass; iter72 has 3 PDF text-marker mismatches (§9/§10/§11 strings replaced by ORB SECTION IX/X/XI — functional content fully preserved, only the old §-marker fixtures need updating).

minor.issue: iter72 regression: 3 tests fail because they grep for literal '§9'/'§10'/'§11'/'last 7 of 8' substrings, but iter73 ORB redesign renames the OTY section to 'SECTION IX — OF THE YEAR HONORS' and 'LAST 7 OF 8' may wrap across lines in extracted text. Underlying functionality (OTY section presence, ordering, 7-cap, zero-wins placeholder) is intact — iter72 fixtures need to drop the §-markers.

action_items: Update iter72 PDF tests (test_personnel_brief_pdf_has_section9_oty, test_personnel_brief_pdf_header_includes_last_7_of_n, test_personnel_brief_pdf_zero_wins_placeholder) to look for 'SECTION IX — OF THE YEAR HONORS' / case-insensitive 'last 7 of 8' / new 'No Of The Year honors on record' placeholder instead of '§9'/'§10'/'§11'.

Fix React console warning: 'React does not recognize the tileTitle prop on a DOM element' inside OrbSummary (Reports.jsx) — prop is being spread onto a native DOM node. Either rename to lowercase data-tile-title, destructure it out of {...rest}, or convert the wrapper to a styled-component.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/reports.py is now 1312 lines — personnel_brief_pdf_response alone is ~480 lines. Recommend extracting the ORB PDF builder into routes/personnel_brief_pdf.py (header/summary-grid/detail-pages as separate functions) to keep file under 700 lines and ease future tweaks.

personnel_brief_data._chapter_for_year does a per-row sort of assignment_history; for members with very long histories this is O(N * A). Negligible today but a precomputed (year → chapter) map outside the row loop would be cleaner.

of_the_year.PUT now silently accepts chapter_id on member categories — comment is good, but consider adding a server-side audit log entry when chapter context changes so admins can trace why a Personnel Brief's auto-resolved chapter was overridden.
Awards.jsx save() always sends chapter_id even when '' — confirm backend ignores empty string (it does: validates only if truthy). Still, send `null` instead of '' for cleaner Mongo state.
Reports.jsx OrbSummary spreads tile descriptor objects directly onto JSX → triggers DOM-prop warning (`tileTitle`). Destructure known props or use a typed component prop list.

rca of the issue: Iter72 PDF tests fail because the iteration 73 ORB redesign replaced compact '§N' section markers with full ALL-CAPS 'SECTION <ROMAN> — <TITLE>' bars (reports.py L853-1106). Behaviour is intact: SECTION IX is the OTY section, the header still notes 'LAST 7 OF 8', and the zero-wins placeholder text 'No Of The Year honors on record' still renders. Mitigation: replace iter72 substring assertions: '§9'→'SECTION IX', '§10'→'SECTION X', '§11'→'SECTION XI', and use re.IGNORECASE for 'last 7 of 8' since pdfplumber extraction inserts a newline after 'LAST 7 OF'. No backend code change required.
